_doc: Ratchet baseline for ci:search-field-completeness (plan SEARCH_FILTER_COMPLETENESS_PLAN_2026-07-30 §11.2/§12, P5). exposedFields may only grow; the two long-tail counts may only shrink. Update deliberately via `node scripts/check-search-field-completeness.mjs --update` after regenerating registry-report.json. mvColumnExclusions is the gate's own exclusion ledger: every listing_search_mv column that is NOT a registry field's mv target and NOT on the curation mask-dead list must appear here with a reason a reviewer can audit. Seeded 2026-07-30 from the post-P5-tranche state (108 fields; long tail 48 standard / 244 custom; live coverage verified per-field in the plan's §12 P5 execution).

mvColumnExclusions.listing_key: Row identity key (RETS ListingKey) — joins and dedupe, not a buyer filter.
mvColumnExclusions.list_number: MLS number — direct lookup runs through resolveCanonicalListingKey, not the filter surface.
mvColumnExclusions.standard_status: Status scope is the FilterSchema `status` enum (active / pending / both), a scope selector rather than a registry field.
mvColumnExclusions.close_price: Sold-scope column; the on-market MV carries it only as a tile projection and it is null on every serving row. Sold search runs on the legacy RPC path.
mvColumnExclusions.close_date: Sold-scope column; null on on-market MV rows. Sold search runs on the legacy RPC path.
mvColumnExclusions.street_number: Address display column for the tile projection — address search is the keywords/search_vector path.
mvColumnExclusions.street_name: Address display column for the tile projection — address search is the keywords/search_vector path.
mvColumnExclusions.street_suffix: Address display column for the tile projection.
mvColumnExclusions.city: Geography is the FilterSchema city/cities layer (city_lower), resolved by the page geography, not a registry field.
mvColumnExclusions.city_lower: Match column for the city geography layer.
mvColumnExclusions.postal_code: Geography: FilterSchema postalCode param, handled by the geography layer.
mvColumnExclusions.subdivision_name: Geography: subdivision layer (matched via subdivision_lower + alias sets).
mvColumnExclusions.subdivision_lower: Match column for the subdivision geography layer.
mvColumnExclusions.boundary_city: Boundary tag for geography resolution, not a buyer filter.
mvColumnExclusions.boundary_neighborhood: Geography: FilterSchema neighborhood param (Bend district labels).
mvColumnExclusions.lat: Geometry for bbox/shape search (FilterSchema bbox + shapes), not a field filter.
mvColumnExclusions.property_type: Class scope is the FilterSchema propertyType param (label -> MLS code set), a scope selector rather than a registry field.
mvColumnExclusions.on_market_date: Recency source for sort + dom derivation; buyer intent is the dom range field.
mvColumnExclusions.price_drop_count: Tile badge count; buyer intent is the priceReduced boolean (price_reduced).
mvColumnExclusions.search_vector: Keyword-search infrastructure behind the keywords field (whose registry mv is public_remarks).
mvColumnExclusions.private_remarks: Broker-only field — never exposed as a public filter; access controlled at the grant layer (rr_private_keys redaction program).
mvColumnExclusions.floor_plans_count: Media count; buyer intent is the hasFloorPlan boolean (has_floor_plan).
mvColumnExclusions.videos_count: Media count; buyer intent is the hasVideo boolean (has_video).
mvColumnExclusions.virtual_tours_count: Media count; buyer intent is the hasVirtualTour boolean (has_virtual_tour).
